name: MCP Server — HTTP transport + auth
description: Adds a network-exposed Streamable-HTTP transport with always-on auth (bearer or OAuth) to the mcp-server base. A transport-factory addon: it plugs into the base's registerTransport seam (no server.ts rewrite) and ships a defense-in-depth startup guard.
checklist: Set MCP_TRANSPORT=streamable-http, MCP_HTTP_PORT, and MCP_AUTH_MODE in .env (see .env.mcp-http.example).
Never run streamable-http with MCP_AUTH_MODE unset or 'none' — the server refuses to start (guard.ts).
bearer: set MCP_BEARER_TOKEN to the shared secret clients send as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.
oauth: set MCP_OAUTH_ISSUER_URL and implement token verification in src/infrastructure/mcp/auth/oauth.ts — it fail-closes (denies all) until you do; install `jose` for JWKS verification.
Verify: start the server (npx tsx bin/cli.ts) and POST an MCP initialize to http://localhost:<port> with a valid Authorization header.
For remote deploy, containerize with the `docker` template.
